name: Automata.acc_lang_acc_union
statement:
theorem acc_lang_acc_union {acc0 acc1 : Set M.State} :
    M.AcceptedLang (acc0 ∪ acc1) = M.AcceptedLang acc0 ∪ M.AcceptedLang acc1

name: Automata.na_FinAccept'_of_FinAccept
statement:
theorem na_FinAccept'_of_FinAccept {n : ℕ} {as : Stream' A}
    (h : M.FinAccept acc n as) : M.FinAccept' acc n (fun k ↦ as k)

name: Automata.na_FinAccept_of_FinAccept'
statement:
theorem na_FinAccept_of_FinAccept' [Inhabited A] {n : ℕ} {as : Fin n → A}
    (h : M.FinAccept' acc n as) : M.FinAccept acc n (fun k ↦ if h : k < n then as ⟨k, h⟩ else default)

name: Automata.na_FinRun'_of_FinRun
statement:
theorem na_FinRun'_of_FinRun {n : ℕ} {as : Stream' A} {ss : Stream' M.State}
    (h : M.FinRun n as ss) : M.FinRun' n (fun k ↦ as k) (fun k ↦ ss k)

name: Automata.na_FinRun_fixSuffix
statement:
theorem na_FinRun_fixSuffix [Inhabited A] {n : ℕ} {as : Stream' A} {ss : Stream' M.State}
    (h : M.FinRun n as ss) : M.FinRun n (fixSuffix as n default) (fixSuffix ss (n + 1) (ss 0))

name: Automata.na_FinRun_imp_FinRun
statement:
theorem na_FinRun_imp_FinRun {m n : ℕ} {as : Stream' A} {ss : Stream' M.State}
    (hmn : m < n) (hr : M.FinRun n as ss) : M.FinRun m as ss

name: Automata.na_FinRun_modulo
statement:
theorem na_FinRun_modulo {n : ℕ} {as as' : Stream' A} {ss ss' : Stream' M.State}
    (ha : ∀ k < n, as k = as' k) (hs : ∀ k < n + 1, ss k = ss' k) (hr : M.FinRun n as ss) : M.FinRun n as' ss'

name: Automata.na_FinRun_of_FinRun'
Automata.na_InfRun_iff_FinRun
statement:
theorem na_InfRun_iff_FinRun {as : Stream' A} {ss : Stream' M.State} :
    M.InfRun as ss ↔ ∀ n, M.FinRun n as ss

name: Automata.acc_lang_inter
statement:
theorem acc_lang_inter [Inhabited A] :
    (NA.Prod M).AcceptedLang (NA.Prod_Acc M acc) = ⋂ i : I, (M i).AcceptedLang (acc i)

name: Automata.na_prod_fin_run
statement:
theorem na_prod_fin_run {n : ℕ} {as : Stream' A} {ss : Stream' (NA.Prod M).State} :
    (NA.Prod M).FinRun n as ss ↔ ∀ i, (M i).FinRun n as (fun k ↦ ss k i)

name: Automata.na_prod_inf_run
statement:
theorem na_prod_inf_run {as : Stream' A} {ss : Stream' (NA.Prod M).State} :
    (NA.Prod M).InfRun as ss ↔ ∀ i, (M i).InfRun as (fun k ↦ ss k i)

name: Stream'.append_extract_drop
statement:
theorem append_extract_drop {xs : Stream' X} {n : ℕ} :
    (xs.extract 0 n) ++ₛ (xs.drop n) = xs

name: Stream'.append_extract_extract
statement:
theorem append_extract_extract {xs : Stream' X} {k m n : ℕ} (h_km : k ≤ m) (h_mn : m ≤ n) :
    (xs.extract k m) ++ (xs.extract m n) = xs.extract k n

name: Stream'.drop_append_of_ge_length
statement:
theorem drop_append_of_ge_length {xl : List X} {xs : Stream' X} {n : ℕ} (h : xl.length ≤ n) :
    (xl ++ₛ xs).drop n = xs.drop (n - xl.length)

name: Stream'.extract_append_zero_right
statement:
theorem extract_append_zero_right {xl : List X} {xs : Stream' X} {n : ℕ} (h : xl.length ≤ n) :
    (xl ++ₛ xs).extract 0 n = xl ++ (xs.extract 0 (n - xl.length))

name: Stream'.extract_apppend_right_right
statement:
theorem extract_apppend_right_right {xl : List X} {xs : Stream' X} {m n : ℕ} (h : xl.length ≤ m) :
    (xl ++ₛ xs).extract m n = xs.extract (m - xl.length) (n - xl.length)

name: Stream'.extract_drop
statement:
theorem extract_drop {xs : Stream' X} {k m n : ℕ} :
    (xs.drop k).extract m n = xs.extract (k + m) (k + n)

name: Stream'.extract_eq_drop_take
statement:
theorem extract_eq_drop_take {xs : Stream' X} {m n : ℕ} :
    xs.extract m n = take (n - m) (xs.drop m)

name: Stream'.extract_eq_extract
Stream'.extract_eq_nil
statement:
theorem extract_eq_nil {xs : Stream' X} {n : ℕ} :
    xs.extract n n = []

name: Stream'.extract_eq_nil_iff
statement:
theorem extract_eq_nil_iff {xs : Stream' X} {m n : ℕ} :
    xs.extract m n = [] ↔ m ≥ n

name: Stream'.extract_eq_ofFn
statement:
theorem extract_eq_ofFn {xs : Stream' X} {m n : ℕ} :
    xs.extract m n = List.ofFn (fun k : Fin (n - m) ↦ xs (m + k))

name: Stream'.extract_eq_take
statement:
theorem extract_eq_take {xs : Stream' X} {n : ℕ} :
    xs.extract 0 n = xs.take n

name: Stream'.extract_extract1
statement:
theorem extract_extract1 {xs : Stream' X} {n i : ℕ} :
    (xs.extract 0 n).extract i = xs.extract i n

name: Stream'.extract_extract2
statement:
theorem extract_extract2 {xs : Stream' X} {n i j : ℕ} (h : j ≤ n) :
    (xs.extract 0 n).extract i j = xs.extract i j

name: Stream'.extract_extract2'
statement:
theorem extract_extract2' {xs : Stream' X} {m n i j : ℕ} (h : j ≤ n - m) :
    (xs.extract m n).extract i j = xs.extract (m + i) (m + j)

name: Stream'.extract_padDefault
statement:
theorem extract_padDefault [Inhabited X] {xl : List X} :
    xl.padDefault.extract 0 xl.length = xl

name: Stream'.extract_succ_right
statement:
theorem extract_succ_right {xs : Stream' X} {m n : ℕ} (h_mn : m ≤ n) :
    xs.extract m (n + 1) = xs.extract m n ++ [xs.get n]

name: Stream'.extract_succ_right'
statement:
theorem extract_succ_right' {xs : Stream' X} {m n : ℕ} (h_mn : m ≤ n) :
    xs.extract m (n + 1) = xs.extract m n ++ [xs n]

name: Stream'.get_append_left'
statement:
theorem get_append_left' {xl : List X} {xs : Stream' X} {k : ℕ} (h : k < xl.length) :
    (xl ++ₛ xs) k = xl[k]

name: Stream'.get_append_right'
statement:
theorem get_append_right' {xl : List X} {xs : Stream' X} {k : ℕ} (h : xl.length ≤ k) :
    (xl ++ₛ xs) k = xs (k - xl.length)

name: Stream'.get_drop'
statement:
theorem get_drop' {xs : Stream' X} {n k : ℕ} :
    (xs.drop n) k = xs (n + k)

name: Stream'.get_extract
statement:
theorem get_extract {xs : Stream' X} {m n k : ℕ} (h : k < n - m) :
    (xs.extract m n)[k]'(by simp only [length_extract, h]) = xs.get (m + k)

name: Stream'.get_extract'
statement:
theorem get_extract' {xs : Stream' X} {m n k : ℕ} (h : k < n - m) :
    (xs.extract m n)[k]'(by simp only [length_extract, h]) = xs (m + k)

name: Stream'.length_extract
statement:
theorem length_extract {xs : Stream' X} {m n : ℕ} :
    (xs.extract m n).length = n - m

name: Stream'.padDefault_elt_left
statement:
theorem padDefault_elt_left [Inhabited X] {xl : List X} {k : ℕ} (h : k < xl.length) :
    xl.padDefault k = xl[k]

name: Stream'.take_one
statement:
theorem take_one {xs : Stream' X} :
    xs.take 1 = [xs.get 0]

name: Stream'.take_one'
statement:
theorem take_one' {xs : Stream' X} :
    xs.take 1 = [xs 0]

name: antitone_fin_eventually
statement:
theorem antitone_fin_eventually {n : ℕ} {f : ℕ → Fin n} (h : Antitone f) :
    ∃ i : Fin n, ∃ m, ∀ k ≥ m, f k = i

name: option_some_pigeonhole
statement:
theorem option_some_pigeonhole {X : Type*} [Finite X] {n : ℕ} (f : Fin n → Option X)
    (h : {j | (f j).isSome}.ncard > Nat.card X) :
    ∃ j1 j2, j1 ≠ j2 ∧ ∃ x, f j1 = some x ∧ f j2 = some x

name: inf_occ_eventually
statement:
theorem inf_occ_eventually {X : Type*} [Finite X] (xs : Stream' X) :
    ∀ᶠ k in atTop, xs k ∈ InfOcc xs

name: inf_occ_suffix
statement:
theorem inf_occ_suffix {X : Type*} (xs : Stream' X) (k : ℕ) :
    InfOcc (xs.drop k) = InfOcc xs

name: base_zero_shift
statement:
lemma base_zero_shift (φ : ℕ → ℕ) :
    (φ · - φ 0) 0 = 0

name: base_zero_strict_mono
statement:
lemma base_zero_strict_mono {φ : ℕ → ℕ} (hm : StrictMono φ) :
    StrictMono (φ · - φ 0)

name: count_out_range_pos
statement:
theorem count_out_range_pos (h0 : φ 0 = 0) (n : ℕ) (hn : n ∉ range φ) :
    Nat.count (· ∈ range φ) n > 0

name: infinite_strict_mono
statement:
theorem infinite_strict_mono {ns : Set ℕ} (h : ns.Infinite) :
    ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ range φ = ns

name: nth_of_strict_mono
statement:
theorem nth_of_strict_mono (hm : StrictMono φ) (n : ℕ) :
    φ n = Nat.nth (· ∈ range φ) n

name: nth_succ_gap
statement:
lemma nth_succ_gap {p : ℕ → Prop} (hf : (Set.ofPred p).Infinite) (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ k < Nat.nth p (n + 1) - Nat.nth p n, k > 0 → ¬ p (k + Nat.nth p n)

name: segment'_idem
statement:
theorem segment'_idem (hm : StrictMono φ) (k : ℕ) :
    Segment' φ (φ k) = k

name: segment'_lower_bound
statement:
theorem segment'_lower_bound (hm : StrictMono φ) {k : ℕ} (h : φ 0 ≤ k) :
    φ (Segment' φ k) ≤ k

name: segment'_lower_val
statement:
theorem segment'_lower_val (hm : StrictMono φ) {m k : ℕ}
    (hl : φ m ≤ k) : m ≤ Segment' φ k

name: segment'_range_val
statement:
theorem segment'_range_val (hm : StrictMono φ) {m k : ℕ}
    (hl : φ m ≤ k) (hu : k < φ (m + 1)) : Segment' φ k = m

name: segment'_upper_bound
statement:
theorem segment'_upper_bound (hm : StrictMono φ) {k : ℕ} (h : φ 0 ≤ k) :
    k < φ (Segment' φ k + 1)

name: segment'_zero
statement:
theorem segment'_zero (hm : StrictMono φ) {k : ℕ} (h : k ≤ φ 0) :
    Segment' φ k = 0

name: segment_galois_connection
statement:
theorem segment_galois_connection (hm : StrictMono φ) (h0 : φ 0 = 0) :
    GaloisConnection φ (Segment φ)

name: segment_idem
statement:
theorem segment_idem (hm : StrictMono φ) (k : ℕ) :
    Segment φ (φ k) = k

name: segment_lower_bound
statement:
theorem segment_lower_bound (hm : StrictMono φ) (h0 : φ 0 = 0) (k : ℕ) :
    φ (Segment φ k) ≤ k

name: segment_plus_one
statement:
theorem segment_plus_one (h0 : φ 0 = 0) (k : ℕ) :
    Segment φ k + 1 = Nat.count (· ∈ range φ) (k + 1)

name: segment_range_gap
statement:
theorem segment_range_gap (hm : StrictMono φ) {m k : ℕ}
    (hl : φ m < k) (hu : k < φ (m + 1)) : k ∉ range φ

name: segment_range_val
statement:
theorem segment_range_val (hm : StrictMono φ) {m k : ℕ}
    (hl : φ m ≤ k) (hu : k < φ (m + 1)) : Segment φ k = m

name: segment_upper_bound
statement:
theorem segment_upper_bound (hm : StrictMono φ) (h0 : φ 0 = 0) (k : ℕ) :
    k < φ (Segment φ k + 1)

name: segment_zero
statement:
theorem segment_zero (hm : StrictMono φ) (h0 : φ 0 = 0) :
    Segment φ 0 = 0

name: strict_mono_infinite
statement:
theorem strict_mono_infinite (hm : StrictMono φ) :
    (range φ).Infinite

name: frequently_leads_to_frequently
statement:
theorem frequently_leads_to_frequently {p q : Set X}
    (h1 : ∃ᶠ k in atTop, xs k ∈ p) (h2 : LeadsTo xs p q) : ∃ᶠ k in atTop, xs k ∈ q

name: leads_to_step
statement:
theorem leads_to_step {p q : Set X}
    (h : Step xs p q) : LeadsTo xs p q

name: leads_to_trans
statement:
theorem leads_to_trans {p q r : Set X}
    (h1 : LeadsTo xs p q) (h2 : LeadsTo xs q r) : LeadsTo xs p r
